Title: Rockwool vs Coco Coir: pH, Water, Yield & Which to Use
Description: Coir out-yielded rockwool by 26% in a tomato slab trial. Rockwool starts at pH 7–8.5 and needs a soak; coir is pH 5.5–6.8 and needs rinsing. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: rockwool vs coco coir hydroponics, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
